items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Pops and Vic Burton got arrested the first time they ever heard of marijuana in California.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. In California in those days there was a lot of unofficial gambling went on. You know, quite openly. And that was the place where Pops and Vic Burton got arrested the first time they ever heard of marijuana in California. They had them on the deal, and they

didn't know what to do about it, because there wasn't any real law in the book covering the thing. So what would happen was they would -- they'd take them to work and let them work, and at the end of the night they'd take them back to jail, while they figured out what they were going to do about it.
